categories.title: Fast Travel Door
categories.info: Unlock fast travel doors to travel between them.

categories.title: Map Pylon
categories.info: Activate the nearby map sensors and then activate this map kit to unlock the map for this district.

categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: An FBC structure that connects one part of the world to another.

categories.title: Player Customization
categories.info: A portable wardrobe that allows you to change customization and outfits.

categories.title: Ability Door
categories.info: An obstacle that can be cleared with a Combat Ability to open the way.

categories.title: Power Core Station
categories.info: Location of a Power Core Station where a charge can be collected.

categories.title: Orientation Point
categories.info: Approach an orientation point to activate it. Upon death, you will respawn here.

categories.title: Resonant Entity
categories.template: Defeating a resonant entity starts a new Resonant Cycle. This resets World Feats and respawns all enemies as tougher variants with better loot.

categories.title: Artifact
categories.template: Collect the blueprint for an artifact and then construct it within the Gap, then equip them in your loadout. Artifacts can be created more than once.

categories.title: Taskboard
categories.info: After saving Simon Arish, speak to Ranger Ruboneka at the Field Office to unlock FBC tasks, then visit Taskboards around the world to start new tasks.

categories.title: Taxi
categories.info: Enter each of the taxi cabs found in the world to progress through The Last Taxi side story.

categories.title: Paranatural Camera
categories.info: Paranatural Cameras are prone to freezing people and running away. Sneak up on them to capture them. The locations of Paranatural Cameras can be revealed by finding Instant Photos around the world.

categories.title: Instant Photo
categories.info: Instant Photos reveal the location of a Paranatural Camera somewhere in the world.

categories.title: FBC Testing Facility
categories.info: Complete the shutdown procedure at each FBC Testing Facility to complete the Unsupervised Science miniquest.

categories.title: Research Balloon
categories.info: Interact with the suspended platform to detach it from the balloon and then break open the crate to find the sensors. Take each sensor to the location indicated on your minimap to activate the research balloon.

categories.title: Sketchbook
categories.info: A piece from a sketchbook scene, completed by placing them together correctly.

categories.title: Arcade Cabinet
categories.info: Each arcade cabinet hosts a unique, replayable challange in SHÜM® III for you to master.

categories.title: Vending Machine
categories.info: Looks like an ordinary vending machine until struck, then flees. Catch it and destroy it for its loot.

categories.title: Large Health Element
categories.info: Large Health Elements found throughout the world restore a large, fixed amount of Health. They cannot be picked up while your Health is full.

categories.title: Command Charge
categories.info: Look for Command Charges in the environment and use them to trigger Command on enemies. These only appear once you have unlocked the Command ability.
